# A01-S31 — Correspondence

Source extract. [████] marks omissions.

On that occasion I remembered that there were previously a couple 
documents on the old website, which you probably have not read. I 
attach them here, because they harmonize very well with your task and a 
possible further collaboration.

Additionally, Hello Humans 12-20 and HH 22 are also written, but not uploaded 
 yet. I enclose Hello Humans 22 here, as it could be 
interesting for your assignment. The rest I can send later, when 
we have talked; there are actually quite a few links related to some of your 
points.
